description: Asks what Val returns for text with leading blanks, internal blanks, a comma, leading or trailing point, signs, a bare or dangling exponent, a d exponent, hex and octal prefixes (including the 16-bit boundary), a doubled point, a fullwidth digit, a tab inside, a currency symbol and an overflowing exponent, and for numeric, Boolean, empty and Null operands. Each call is its own snapshot SELECT expr, VarType(expr), TypeName(expr) FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
